verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting is documented as alerting on metrics, logs, and traces from multiple data sources in a single consolidated view, and it sends notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie and others. Community users confirm alerting across many backends, including SQL-based alerts routed just like Prometheus alerts, and on-call escalation is documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of notification grouping, explicit evidence of silencing/muting, and in-depth docs on routing policies (routing is only shown through notification targets and a community mention).
